name: Force 120 FPS
description: Runs Geometry Dash at 120 FPS on PC, Mac, and 120 Hz phones and tablets.

target-fps.name: Target FPS
target-fps.description: Frame rate the game is forced to run at. Default is 120.

disable-vsync.name: Disable VSync (PC/Mac)
disable-vsync.description: VSync caps the game at your monitor's refresh rate. Turn it off so 120 FPS works even on a 60 Hz monitor. Has no effect on phones, which always sync to the screen.
